CHANGELOG updated in DEADWEIGHT: Android (S555 phase 1B): brutalist menu/title-screen parity with the Windows client + zero-friction IDUNA auth (fixed Config.DEFAULT_IDUNA_URL, was empty -- Android had no account/tickets by default). New PixelLabel.java/BrutButton.java; GuestAuth gained tickets/isGuest/redeem()/upgrade()/emailLogin(). Compile-checked against real android.* stubs, CoreTest's live guestAuth() test (228 checks) passes. (sess-20260923-1030-4a526255)

⚓ ☃
